integrity: Proof of the universal bound and the all-order extremal thresholds is given in RESULT.md. Positive certificates, enumeration algorithms, and recorded outputs are embedded and independently reproducible. Source dates refer to public supporting literature, not claimed dates of the new theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted connected simple trees; closed radius exactly two; complete ordinary binary Littlestone shattering. No claim for other radii, weighted graphs, general graph metrics, randomized dimensions, or a closed form for the dimension of each tree. The sixteen-vertex census is exact computational enumeration, with two separately implemented checks; no independent external audit or absolute historical priority guarantee.
title: Radius-two tree balls have a sharp four-round online-shattering ceiling
